name: hunt_fv_fvg15_vwap_p30

source.title: Claude hunt 2026-10-20 (lens: fair value gaps with a volume side): the plain 15-minute fair value gap retest, taken only on the side of the session VWAP, 30-point stop, 45-point target, once in each New York pass. Why it should pay: the VWAP is the average price of the session's volume, so above it the buyers of the session are in profit and in control; a 15-minute up gap above the VWAP is their unfilled buying, and the return to it meets that interest (the mirror below). Who loses: the traders who fade the session's volume side into the gap and whose stops beyond it pay for the continuation.

entry.words: Any 15-minute fair value gap of the session pass at least 0.1 x ATR(14) tall: a limit at its near edge, with the gap, but a buy only when the gap's close is above the session VWAP and a sell only when below it. The newest gap replaces an older resting order. No new order from 15:00. Stop 30 points, target 45 points. One trade per session pass.

No number was tuned to those results
not_run: THE VWAP: the engine's session VWAP, which restarts at each pass start (09:30, 11:00 and 13:30 ET); the gate reads (close - VWAP) / sigma at the gap's 15-minute close (closed bars only): above 0 for a buy, below 0 for a sell, checked when the order is placed.
THE STOP: 30 points fixed from the entry, not the gap's far edge (the family's own structure level is the gap's far edge, a stop too close for the PREREG).

ENGINE: one instance per session pass; a gap cannot span 11:00 or 13:30 (its three bars must lie in one pass); the newest gap of either side replaces the resting order even when the gate then blocks it.
THE CAP: one trade per session pass; three passes, so a day can hold up to 3 trades, and a trade of one pass may still be open when the next pass enters.
WINDOW: no new order from 15:00 (w_end); an order placed before 15:00 may still fill after it.

PARTLY SEEN, FOR THE FAMILY: plain fvg entries were never walk-forwarded in the taught lane, but the open-side cousin (fvg_oside) used the same gaps on the same months and was read; the VWAP-side subset here is different trades.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay, strict limit fills).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ by this sheet: build days only.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days).
